ValidationRule.description: # This Validation will fire when Country is Turkey and Tax Exempt = Yes the we should select one reason for Tax Exempt Type
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Account'))), RecordType.DeveloperName = $Label.QTB_AccountRecordType_Billing, AND( ISPICKVAL( QTB_Legal_Entity_Country__c , 'Turkey') , ISPICKVAL( SBQQ__TaxExempt__c , 'Yes') ), ISBLANK( TEXT( QTB_Tax_Exemption_Type__c ) )
)
